intro: A short notice the app shows once per device (from version 1.2.4). It stays off until you switch it on. Every save is recorded in the audit log.
scope_both_note: Shown on any platform that has no active notice of its own.
switch_label: Show the notice in the app
rule_plain: Plain text only: no links, web addresses, e-mail addresses or markup.
rule_payment: No pointer to payment or a subscription outside the store (Apple 3.1.1, Google Play Billing).
rule_ios: On iPhone (and "Both platforms"): none of the words בהרצה, בטא, beta, ניסיון, trial, test version (Apple 2.2).
rule_version: Changing the title or text raises the version, so the notice shows once more on every device. Switching it on or off does not.
err_empty: Fill in the title and the text.
err_markup: The characters < and > are not allowed.
err_links: Links and addresses are not allowed.
err_beta: The word "{{word}}" is not allowed on iPhone (Apple 2.2).
